set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §2 concern 5, §3 Phase 1b.

Agreement did not track accuracy (a constant anchor scores 0 s). Risk-coverage ranked units by the argmax's mass while the decode moves 57% of anchors (risk_coverage.py:33).

Scope:
Fix what risk-coverage ranks by; remove agreement from decoder selection.

Acceptance criteria:
1. risk_coverage.py ranks by a score attached to the final emitted decision; scene mass and leaf mass are recorded separately; fill decisions and missing scores are identified explicitly.
2. The 2026-09-04 risk-coverage result is recomputed and the ledger records the corrected reading.
3. Agreement is removed from every decoder-selection path and documented as diagnostic only; a test shows the decoder-selection script does not read agreement.
4. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: S-M.
set.title: Phase 1b: repair the instruments -- risk-coverage on the emitted decision; retire agreement as a decoder judge
